name: Vanillite
author: hthoene@users.noreply.github.com
description: Vanillite: a Minecraft Java Edition server written in Rust that behaves like Vanilla in game; fast, multithreaded and low on RAM. The startup page shows the essential settings first, then every server.properties and vanillite.toml setting, grouped by area. For only the basic settings use the egg "Vanillite (Simple)". The image (Startup page) picks the Minecraft version; "Latest Minecraft" follows new versions on the next restart, other new versions appear after re-importing this egg. https://github.com/hthoene/vanillite

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# Vanillite needs no installation: the image holds the server, and the first start downloads
# Mojang's server jar for the Vanilla data into cache/.
mkdir -p /mnt/server
echo "Nothing to install."

variables.name: Accept the Minecraft EULA
variables.description: Switch on to accept the Minecraft EULA (https://aka.ms/MinecraftEULA); the server does not start before (the panel's EULA prompt does the same).

variables.name: Profile
variables.description: Preset of all technical settings below: vanilla (exactly like Vanilla), technical (Vanilla plus what technical players need), paper or spigot (their defaults) or performance (faster, deviates a little from Vanilla).

variables.name: Server Description (MOTD)
variables.description: The text shown below the server in the multiplayer list.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: How many players can be online at the same time.

variables.name: Game Mode
variables.description: The game mode of players who join for the first time.

variables.name: Difficulty
variables.description: The difficulty of the world.

variables.name: Hardcore
variables.description: Hardcore mode: the difficulty is locked to hard and players have one life.

variables.name: Online Mode
variables.description: Only players with a Minecraft account checked by Mojang can join; switch off only behind a proxy that checks the accounts.

variables.name: Whitelist
variables.description: Only players on the whitelist (/whitelist add <name>) can join.

variables.name: World Seed
variables.description: The seed of a new world; empty picks a random one (no effect on an existing world).

variables.name: View Distance
variables.description: How far players can see, in chunks (2 to 32, default 10).

variables.name: Simulation Distance
variables.description: How far around players the world is alive (mobs, crops, redstone), in chunks (2 to 32, default 10).

variables.name: Bedrock Players
variables.description: Let Bedrock Edition players join, on the server's port (UDP) unless "Bedrock: Port" says otherwise.

variables.name: Server: Log Level
variables.description: Console log level: error, warn, info, debug or trace. Default: info.

variables.name: Server: Accepts Transfers
variables.description: Accept transfers of players from other servers. Default: false. server.properties: accepts-transfers.

variables.name: Server: Allow Flight
variables.description: Allow flight in survival (otherwise flying players are kicked). Default: false. server.properties: allow-flight.

variables.name: Server: Broadcast Console To Ops
variables.description: Send console command output to operators. Default: true. server.properties: broadcast-console-to-ops.

variables.name: Server: Broadcast RCON To Ops
variables.description: Send RCON command output to operators. Default: true. server.properties: broadcast-rcon-to-ops.

variables.name: Server: Chat Spam Threshold Seconds
variables.description: Seconds of chat spam (each message counts one second, each tick takes 1/20 away) after which non-operators are kicked; 0 disables. Default: 10. server.properties: chat-spam-threshold-seconds.

variables.name: Server: Command Spam Threshold Seconds
variables.description: Like `chat-spam-threshold-seconds`, for commands. Default: 10. server.properties: command-spam-threshold-seconds.

variables.name: Server: Bug Report Link
variables.description: Link shown as "report bug" in the client. Default: empty. Empty: the value in server.properties. server.properties: bug-report-link.

variables.name: Server: Enable Code Of Conduct
variables.description: Show the code of conduct to joining players. Default: false. server.properties: enable-code-of-conduct.

variables.name: Server: Enable Query
variables.description: Enable the GameSpy4 query listener. Default: false. server.properties: enable-query.

variables.name: Server: Enable RCON
variables.description: Enable remote console access. Default: false. server.properties: enable-rcon.

variables.name: Server: Enable Status
variables.description: Answer server list pings. Default: true. server.properties: enable-status.

variables.name: Server: Enforce Secure Profile
variables.description: Require chat signing keys from Mojang. Default: true. server.properties: enforce-secure-profile.

variables.name: Server: Enforce Whitelist
variables.description: Kick players not on the whitelist when it is reloaded. Default: false. server.properties: enforce-whitelist.

variables.name: Server: Entity Broadcast Range Percentage
variables.description: Entity tracking range in percent of the default. Range: 10 to 1000. Default: 100. server.properties: entity-broadcast-range-percentage.

variables.name: Server: Force Gamemode
variables.description: Force players into the default game mode on join. Default: false. server.properties: force-gamemode.

variables.name: Server: Function Permission Level
variables.description: Permission level of functions. Range: 1 to 4. Default: 2. server.properties: function-permission-level.

variables.name: Server: Generate Structures
variables.description: Generate structures in new chunks. Default: true. server.properties: generate-structures.

variables.name: Server: Generator Settings
variables.description: Settings of the flat and customised generators (JSON). Default: {}. Empty: the value in server.properties. server.properties: generator-settings.

variables.name: Server: Hide Online Players
variables.description: Hide the player sample in the server list. Default: false. server.properties: hide-online-players.

variables.name: Server: Initial Disabled Packs
variables.description: Data packs disabled when the world is created. Default: empty. Empty: the value in server.properties. server.properties: initial-disabled-packs.

variables.name: Server: Initial Enabled Packs
variables.description: Data packs enabled when the world is created. Default: vanilla. Empty: the value in server.properties. server.properties: initial-enabled-packs.

variables.name: Server: Level Name
variables.description: World folder name. Default: world. Empty: the value in server.properties. server.properties: level-name.

variables.name: Server: Level Type
variables.description: World preset of new worlds. Default: minecraft:normal. Empty: the value in server.properties. server.properties: level-type.

variables.name: Server: Log IPs
variables.description: Log client IP addresses. Default: true. server.properties: log-ips.

variables.name: Server: Max Chained Neighbor Updates
variables.description: Maximum chained neighbour updates before skipping. Default: 1000000. server.properties: max-chained-neighbor-updates.

variables.name: Server: Max Tick Time
variables.description: Milliseconds a single tick may take before the watchdog stops the server; -1 disables. Default: 60000. server.properties: max-tick-time.

variables.name: Server: Max World Size
variables.description: Maximum world border radius. Range: 1 to 29999984. Default: 29999984. server.properties: max-world-size.

variables.name: Server: Network Compression Threshold
variables.description: Packets larger than this many bytes are compressed; -1 disables compression. Default: 256. server.properties: network-compression-threshold.

variables.name: Server: Op Permission Level
variables.description: Permission level of operators. Range: 0 to 4. Default: 4. server.properties: op-permission-level.

variables.name: Server: Pause When Empty Seconds
variables.description: Seconds without players after which the server stops ticking; 0 disables. Default: 60. server.properties: pause-when-empty-seconds.

variables.name: Server: Player Idle Timeout
variables.description: Minutes of inactivity before a player is kicked; 0 disables. Default: 0. server.properties: player-idle-timeout.

variables.name: Server: Prevent Proxy Connections
variables.description: Kick players whose IP differs from the one Mojang saw. Default: false. server.properties: prevent-proxy-connections.

variables.name: Server: Query Port
variables.description: Port of the query listener. Range: 1 to 65535. Default: 25565. server.properties: query.port.

variables.name: Server: Rate Limit
variables.description: Maximum packets per second before a player is kicked; 0 disables. Default: 0. server.properties: rate-limit.

variables.name: Server: RCON Password
variables.description: RCON password. Default: empty. Empty: the value in server.properties. server.properties: rcon.password.

variables.name: Server: RCON Port
variables.description: RCON port. Range: 1 to 65535. Default: 25575. server.properties: rcon.port.

variables.name: Server: Region File Compression
variables.description: Compression of chunks in region files. Default: deflate. server.properties: region-file-compression.

variables.name: Server: Require Resource Pack
variables.description: Kick players who decline the resource pack. Default: false. server.properties: require-resource-pack.

variables.name: Server: Resource Pack
variables.description: Resource pack URL. Default: empty. Empty: the value in server.properties. server.properties: resource-pack.

variables.name: Server: Resource Pack ID
variables.description: Resource pack UUID. Default: empty. Empty: the value in server.properties. server.properties: resource-pack-id.

variables.name: Server: Resource Pack Prompt
variables.description: Resource pack prompt (text component). Default: empty. Empty: the value in server.properties. server.properties: resource-pack-prompt.

variables.name: Server: Resource Pack SHA-1
variables.description: Resource pack SHA-1. Default: empty. Empty: the value in server.properties. server.properties: resource-pack-sha1.

variables.name: Server: Spawn Protection
variables.description: Radius around the spawn only operators may build in. Default: 16. server.properties: spawn-protection.

variables.name: Server: Status Heartbeat Interval
variables.description: Seconds between status heartbeats to the management server; 0 disables. Default: 0. server.properties: status-heartbeat-interval.

variables.name: Server: Sync Chunk Writes
variables.description: Flush region files synchronously. Default: true. server.properties: sync-chunk-writes.

variables.name: Performance: Tick › Parallel Dimensions
variables.description: Dimensions tick in parallel, each on its own thread (decision D2). Cross-dimension effects then apply at the end of the tick instead of immediately: an entity entering a portal from the overworld arrives one tick later, `execute in` other dimensions runs at the end of the tick. `false` (the `vanilla` and `technical` profiles) ticks the dimensions one after another in Vanilla's exact order. default: the profile's value (vanilla profile: false). vanillite.toml: performance.tick.parallel-dimensions.

variables.name: Performance: Threads › Compute
variables.description: Worker threads of the compute pool (world generation, lighting, saving, parallel tick phases). 0 = the cores the server may use (`performance.budget.cpu`, the cgroup CPU quota and the CPU affinity): the workers run at a lower OS priority (`compute-nice`), so the tick threads still get a core whenever they need one. Range: 0 to 1024. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 0). vanillite.toml: performance.threads.compute.

variables.name: Performance: Threads › Compute Nice
variables.description: Nice value of the compute workers (Linux; the tick threads stay at 0). Higher values leave the CPU to the tick threads sooner: 10 gives a tick thread sharing a core with a worker about 90 % of it. 0 = the same priority as the tick threads. Range: 0 to 19. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 10). vanillite.toml: performance.threads.compute-nice.

variables.name: Performance: Threads › Network
variables.description: I/O threads of the network (connections, encryption, compression of outgoing packets). 0 = one per two cores, at least 2; 1 with less than two cores, so the tick keeps the only core. Range: 0 to 64. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 0). vanillite.toml: performance.threads.network.

variables.name: Performance: Threads › Tick Phases
variables.description: Threads that share a parallel phase of a world's tick (in crowds: the entity packets, the delivery of sounds and particles, the advancement checks; with players spread out: the ticking checks of the chunks for natural spawning and random ticks; the tiles of `region-threading`), the tick thread included. 0 = one per core the server may use; 1 = the tick thread alone. The other threads are tick helpers at the tick threads' OS priority (not the compute workers, which run below it). The result is the same with any number, only the speed differs. Range: 0 to 1024. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 0). vanillite.toml: performance.threads.tick-phases.

variables.name: Performance: Budget › Cpu
variables.description: CPU cores the server may use. 0 = detect: the cgroup CPU quota (`cpu.max`, Docker `--cpus`, Pterodactyl's CPU limit) and the CPU affinity. Range: 0 to 1024. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 0.0). vanillite.toml: performance.budget.cpu.

variables.name: Performance: Budget › Memory
variables.description: Memory in MiB the server should stay far below; caches are sized from it. 0 = detect: the cgroup memory limit (`memory.max`), none without a container. Range: 0 to 16777216. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 0). vanillite.toml: performance.budget.memory.

variables.name: Performance: Memory › Release When Empty
variables.description: Seconds without players after which the server frees what it can build again: the tables of the world generators, structure templates and caches. They come back in the background when a player joins (new chunks then start a moment later, chunks from disk do not wait). In-game behaviour does not change; disabled keeps everything in memory. Range: 1 to 86400. Also accepts disabled. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 60). vanillite.toml: performance.memory.release-when-empty.

variables.name: Performance: Autosave › Interval
variables.description: Ticks between autosaves. Vanilla saves every 5 minutes of game time. Range: 20 to 1728000. Also accepts vanilla. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: vanilla). vanillite.toml: performance.autosave.interval.

variables.name: Performance: Survival › Time Sync Interval
variables.description: Ticks between the game time packets every player gets (Vanilla: every second). Clients run the clocks themselves in between; a longer interval saves traffic with many players, the game time on the client may then lag behind a little. Range: 1 to 1200. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 20). vanillite.toml: performance.survival.time-sync-interval.

variables.name: Performance: Redstone › Implementation
variables.description: The redstone wire implementation. "vanilla" is tick-exact. "alternate-current" follows Alternate Current (by Space Walker, MIT): a change computes the power of the whole connected wire network in one pass and then updates every block around the changed wires once, instead of Vanilla's recursive updates with thousands of redundant ones. Final wire powers are the same as Vanilla's, but the order of the neighbour and shape updates differs: it follows the direction power flows in (front, back, right, left, down, up of each wire, wires nearest the change first) instead of Vanilla's location-dependent hash order, so a circuit behaves the same in every rotation and place, but contraptions that depend on Vanilla's update order (some piston and observer builds) can behave differently. Wires powered only by blocks update north first. Only the `performance` profile uses it (Paper's own default is its vanilla wire); set "vanilla" there if such a contraption breaks. default: the profile's value (vanilla profile: vanilla). vanillite.toml: performance.redstone.implementation.

variables.name: Performance: Distances › View Distance
variables.description: View distance in chunks; "vanilla" uses `view-distance` of server.properties. Applies to every world. Range: 2 to 32. Also accepts vanilla. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: vanilla). vanillite.toml: performance.distances.view-distance.

variables.name: Performance: Distances › Simulation Distance
variables.description: Simulation distance in chunks; "vanilla" uses `simulation-distance` of server.properties. Applies to every world. Range: 2 to 32. Also accepts vanilla. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: vanilla). vanillite.toml: performance.distances.simulation-distance.

variables.name: Performance: Entity Tracking › Player Range
variables.description: Tracking range of players. Applies to every world. Range: 8 to 512. Also accepts vanilla. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: vanilla). vanillite.toml: performance.entity-tracking.player-range.

variables.name: Performance: Entity Tracking › Animal Range
variables.description: Tracking range of animals, ambient and water mobs. Applies to every world. Range: 8 to 512. Also accepts vanilla. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: vanilla). vanillite.toml: performance.entity-tracking.animal-range.

variables.name: Performance: Entity Tracking › Monster Range
variables.description: Tracking range of monsters. Applies to every world. Range: 8 to 512. Also accepts vanilla. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: vanilla). vanillite.toml: performance.entity-tracking.monster-range.

variables.name: Performance: Entity Tracking › Misc Range
variables.description: Tracking range of everything else (items, projectiles, vehicles, decorations). Applies to every world. Range: 8 to 512. Also accepts vanilla. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: vanilla). vanillite.toml: performance.entity-tracking.misc-range.

variables.name: Performance: Entity Tracking › Overload Tick Millis
variables.description: Overload protection: while a world tick takes longer than this many milliseconds (smoothed), movement updates of tracked entities (position, rotation, head) are sent less often, up to `overload-max-interval-scale` times their Vanilla interval, and back at the Vanilla rate once ticks are fast again. Spawns, removals and entity data are never delayed. "disabled" keeps Vanilla's intervals: an overloaded server then slows down like Vanilla. Applies to every world. Range: 1 to 1000. Also accepts disabled. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: disabled). vanillite.toml: performance.entity-tracking.overload-tick-millis.

variables.name: Performance: Entity Tracking › Overload Max Interval Scale
variables.description: Largest factor on the movement update interval under overload. Applies to every world. Range: 1 to 20. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 4). vanillite.toml: performance.entity-tracking.overload-max-interval-scale.

variables.name: Performance: Crowd › Near Radius
variables.description: Players farther than this many blocks (horizontally) from a viewer are in its far tier: their movement, rotation and head reach that viewer every `far-interval` ticks instead of with every Vanilla update. Coming nearer, the viewer gets their exact position at once. Deviation: far players move less smoothly (the client interpolates between the updates). "disabled" sends every player's movement to everyone at Vanilla's rate. Applies to every world. Range: 8 to 512. Also accepts disabled. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: disabled). vanillite.toml: performance.crowd.near-radius.

variables.name: Performance: Crowd › Far Interval
variables.description: Ticks between two movement updates of a far player (`near-radius`). Applies to every world. Range: 2 to 64. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 8). vanillite.toml: performance.crowd.far-interval.

variables.name: Performance: Crowd › Max Visible Players
variables.description: Players each player sees at most: only the nearest ones are spawned for it (with some slack, so the set does not change at every step); the others stay in the tab list and on the locator bar. Deviation: players beyond the limit are invisible. Bounds the traffic of a crowd to players × this value. "disabled" shows every player within the tracking range. Applies to every world. Range: 8 to 100000. Also accepts disabled. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: disabled). vanillite.toml: performance.crowd.max-visible-players.

variables.name: Performance: Crowd › Waypoint Interval
variables.description: Ticks between two position updates of a player on the locator bar (changes of visibility, team colour and view still apply at once). Deviation: with more than 1, the locator bar follows moving players with a delay of up to this many ticks. Applies to every world. Range: 1 to 100. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 1). vanillite.toml: performance.crowd.waypoint-interval.

variables.name: Performance: Chunks › Unload Delay
variables.description: Ticks a chunk stays loaded after no player or ticket needs it, so walking back does not load it again. Applies to every world. Range: 0 to 6000. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 100). vanillite.toml: performance.chunks.unload-delay.

variables.name: Performance: Chunks › Max Jobs
variables.description: Background chunk jobs (loads, generation steps, light) in flight per world. Higher values load faster with many players at the cost of memory for queued work. Applies to every world. Range: 1 to 4096. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 64). vanillite.toml: performance.chunks.max-jobs.

variables.name: Performance: Region Threading › Enabled
variables.description: Turns the tile region mode on: natural mob spawning and random ticks of a world are worked out per tile (a fixed square of chunks) on several cores. Faster when players are spread out; no gain for a crowd in one place. Deviation: these phases draw their random numbers per tile, so a seeded world differs from Vanilla (same rates), and a player's mob cap can be exceeded by one tick's spawns at a tile border. On in the performance profile; `false` keeps Vanilla's exact serial order at no cost. Applies to every world. default: the profile's value (vanilla profile: false). vanillite.toml: performance.region-threading.enabled.

variables.name: Performance: Region Threading › Tile Size
variables.description: Edge of a tile in chunks. Smaller tiles balance better over the cores, larger ones cost less bookkeeping. Applies to every world. Range: 8 to 32. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 16). vanillite.toml: performance.region-threading.tile-size.

variables.name: Performance: Simulation › Max Block Ticks
variables.description: Scheduled block ticks run per tick. Applies to every world. Range: 1 to 1000000. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 65536). vanillite.toml: performance.simulation.max-block-ticks.

variables.name: Performance: Simulation › Max Fluid Ticks
variables.description: Scheduled fluid ticks run per tick. Applies to every world. Range: 1 to 1000000. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 65536). vanillite.toml: performance.simulation.max-fluid-ticks.

variables.name: Performance: Simulation › Max Chained Neighbor Updates
variables.description: Chained neighbour and shape updates of one block change before the rest is skipped; "vanilla" uses `max-chained-neighbor-updates` of server.properties. Applies to every world. Range: 1 to 100000000. Also accepts vanilla. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: vanilla). vanillite.toml: performance.simulation.max-chained-neighbor-updates.

variables.name: Performance: Simulation › Max Relights Per Tick
variables.description: Chunks whose light is updated together after block changes, in one background job that recomputes only the cells the changes reach; the rest follows in the next job. Lower values split bursts into smaller jobs. Applies to every world. Range: 1 to 65536. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 1024). vanillite.toml: performance.simulation.max-relights-per-tick.

variables.name: Performance: Collisions › Max Entity Collisions
variables.description: Entities a mob pushes and is pushed by per tick (`pushEntities`). Saves the push work in crowded mob pens and farms. Deviation: in a crowd of more entities only the first ones push, so crowds spread more slowly; cramming damage still counts every entity. "vanilla" pushes all. Applies to every world. Range: 0 to 1024. Also accepts vanilla. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: vanilla). vanillite.toml: performance.collisions.max-entity-collisions.

variables.name: Performance: Mobs › Path Nodes Per Tick
variables.description: Path finding nodes all mobs of the world may visit per tick; searches over the budget fail and are retried later. 0 = unlimited (Vanilla). Applies to every world. Range: 0 to 10000000. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 0). vanillite.toml: performance.mobs.path-nodes-per-tick.

variables.name: Performance: Activation Range › Animals
variables.description: Range of animals (`creature` and `ambient` mobs: cows, sheep, bats, ...). Applies to every world. Range: 0 to 128. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 0). vanillite.toml: performance.activation-range.animals.

variables.name: Performance: Activation Range › Monsters
variables.description: Range of monsters (`monster` mobs that are no raiders or flyers). Applies to every world. Range: 0 to 128. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 0). vanillite.toml: performance.activation-range.monsters.

variables.name: Performance: Activation Range › Raiders
variables.description: Range of raiders (pillagers, vindicators, evokers, illusioners, witches and ravagers). Applies to every world. Range: 0 to 128. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 0). vanillite.toml: performance.activation-range.raiders.

variables.name: Performance: Activation Range › Misc
variables.description: Range of the other mobs (golems, armor stands, ...). Applies to every world. Range: 0 to 128. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 0). vanillite.toml: performance.activation-range.misc.

variables.name: Performance: Activation Range › Water
variables.description: Range of water mobs (fish, squid, dolphins, axolotls, ...). Applies to every world. Range: 0 to 128. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 0). vanillite.toml: performance.activation-range.water.

variables.name: Performance: Activation Range › Villagers
variables.description: Range of villagers and wandering traders. Applies to every world. Range: 0 to 128. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 0). vanillite.toml: performance.activation-range.villagers.

variables.name: Performance: Activation Range › Flying
variables.description: Range of flying monsters (ghasts, phantoms, blazes, vexes). Applies to every world. Range: 0 to 128. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 0). vanillite.toml: performance.activation-range.flying.

variables.name: Performance: Activation Range › Villagers Work Immunity After
variables.description: Ticks an inactive villager must have been inactive before it becomes active while it works at its job site, so workstations keep restocking trades; 0 = never. Applies to every world. Range: 0 to 12000. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 0). vanillite.toml: performance.activation-range.villagers-work-immunity-after.

variables.name: Performance: Activation Range › Villagers Work Immunity For
variables.description: Ticks a working villager then stays active. Applies to every world. Range: 0 to 12000. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 0). vanillite.toml: performance.activation-range.villagers-work-immunity-for.

variables.name: Performance: Activation Range › Villagers Active For Panic
variables.description: Panicking villagers stay active (they flee and alarm the village, which spawns iron golems). Applies to every world. default: the profile's value (vanilla profile: false). vanillite.toml: performance.activation-range.villagers-active-for-panic.

variables.name: Performance: Activation Range › Inactive Mob Goal Selector Throttle
variables.description: Ticks between the goal and target selector runs of an inactive mob between its full ticks: it notices targets, food and partners sooner, but does not move before its next full tick. Lower values cost more. "disabled": inactive mobs choose goals only in their full ticks (cheapest). Applies to every world. Range: 1 to 20. Also accepts disabled. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: disabled). vanillite.toml: performance.activation-range.inactive-mob-goal-selector-throttle.

variables.name: Performance: Activation Range Wake Up Inactive › Animals Max Per Tick
variables.description: Animals woken up per tick at most. Applies to every world. Range: 0 to 1000. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 0). vanillite.toml: performance.activation-range.wake-up-inactive.animals-max-per-tick.

variables.name: Performance: Activation Range Wake Up Inactive › Animals Every
variables.description: Ticks animals must have been inactive before they may be woken up. Applies to every world. Range: 1 to 1728000. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 1200). vanillite.toml: performance.activation-range.wake-up-inactive.animals-every.

variables.name: Performance: Activation Range Wake Up Inactive › Animals For
variables.description: Ticks woken up animals stay active. Applies to every world. Range: 1 to 12000. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 100). vanillite.toml: performance.activation-range.wake-up-inactive.animals-for.

variables.name: Performance: Activation Range Wake Up Inactive › Villagers Max Per Tick
variables.description: Villagers woken up per tick at most. Applies to every world. Range: 0 to 1000. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 0). vanillite.toml: performance.activation-range.wake-up-inactive.villagers-max-per-tick.

variables.name: Performance: Activation Range Wake Up Inactive › Villagers Every
variables.description: Ticks villagers must have been inactive before they may be woken up. Applies to every world. Range: 1 to 1728000. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 600). vanillite.toml: performance.activation-range.wake-up-inactive.villagers-every.

variables.name: Performance: Activation Range Wake Up Inactive › Villagers For
variables.description: Ticks woken up villagers stay active. Applies to every world. Range: 1 to 12000. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 100). vanillite.toml: performance.activation-range.wake-up-inactive.villagers-for.

variables.name: Performance: Activation Range Wake Up Inactive › Monsters Max Per Tick
variables.description: Monsters woken up per tick at most. Applies to every world. Range: 0 to 1000. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 0). vanillite.toml: performance.activation-range.wake-up-inactive.monsters-max-per-tick.

variables.name: Performance: Activation Range Wake Up Inactive › Monsters Every
variables.description: Ticks monsters must have been inactive before they may be woken up. Applies to every world. Range: 1 to 1728000. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 400). vanillite.toml: performance.activation-range.wake-up-inactive.monsters-every.

variables.name: Performance: Activation Range Wake Up Inactive › Monsters For
variables.description: Ticks woken up monsters stay active. Applies to every world. Range: 1 to 12000. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 100). vanillite.toml: performance.activation-range.wake-up-inactive.monsters-for.

variables.name: Performance: Activation Range Wake Up Inactive › Flying Max Per Tick
variables.description: Flying woken up per tick at most. Applies to every world. Range: 0 to 1000. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 0). vanillite.toml: performance.activation-range.wake-up-inactive.flying-max-per-tick.

variables.name: Performance: Activation Range Wake Up Inactive › Flying Every
variables.description: Ticks flying must have been inactive before they may be woken up. Applies to every world. Range: 1 to 1728000. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 200). vanillite.toml: performance.activation-range.wake-up-inactive.flying-every.

variables.name: Performance: Activation Range Wake Up Inactive › Flying For
variables.description: Ticks woken up flying stay active. Applies to every world. Range: 1 to 12000. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 100). vanillite.toml: performance.activation-range.wake-up-inactive.flying-for.

variables.name: Performance: Items › Despawn Ticks
variables.description: Ticks an item lies on the ground before it despawns. Lower values keep fewer item entities around on busy servers. Applies to every world. Range: 20 to 32766. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 6000). vanillite.toml: performance.items.despawn-ticks.

variables.name: Performance: Items › Merge Radius
variables.description: Horizontal radius in blocks within which equal item stacks merge into one entity (vertically the radius minus 0.5). Fewer item entities to tick, track and send near farms and mob grinders. Deviation: with more than Vanilla's 0.5, items lying apart jump together into one stack. Applies to every world. Range: 0.5 to 16. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 0.5). vanillite.toml: performance.items.merge-radius.

variables.name: Performance: Items › XP Merge Radius
variables.description: Radius in blocks within which experience orbs of the same value merge (Vanilla's scan every 20 ticks). Fewer orb entities after mob grinders. Deviation: with more than Vanilla's 0.5, orbs lying apart merge and fly to the player as one. Applies to every world. Range: 0.5 to 16. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 0.5). vanillite.toml: performance.items.xp-merge-radius.

variables.name: Performance: Items › Arrow Despawn Ticks
variables.description: Ticks an arrow stuck in a block stays before it despawns. Fewer arrow entities on PvP servers and around skeletons. Deviation: arrows vanish earlier than Vanilla's 60 seconds. Applies to every world. Range: 20 to 1200. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 1200). vanillite.toml: performance.items.arrow-despawn-ticks.

variables.name: Performance: Spawning › Spawn Interval
variables.description: Ticks between natural spawn rounds of monsters, ambient and water mobs (animals keep Vanilla's 400). Saves spawn attempts, which cost a lot with many players. Deviation: caps refill more slowly after mobs die (mob farms produce less). Applies to every world. Range: 1 to 400. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 1). vanillite.toml: performance.spawning.spawn-interval.

variables.name: Performance: Spawning › Monster Cap
variables.description: Mob cap of monsters (Vanilla 70). Fewer mobs to tick; fewer monsters at night. Applies to every world. Range: 0 to 1000. Also accepts vanilla. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: vanilla). vanillite.toml: performance.spawning.monster-cap.

variables.name: Performance: Spawning › Creature Cap
variables.description: Mob cap of animals (`creature`, Vanilla 10). Applies to every world. Range: 0 to 1000. Also accepts vanilla. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: vanilla). vanillite.toml: performance.spawning.creature-cap.

variables.name: Performance: Spawning › Ambient Cap
variables.description: Mob cap of bats (`ambient`, Vanilla 15). Applies to every world. Range: 0 to 1000. Also accepts vanilla. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: vanilla). vanillite.toml: performance.spawning.ambient-cap.

variables.name: Performance: Spawning › Axolotls Cap
variables.description: Mob cap of axolotls (Vanilla 5). Applies to every world. Range: 0 to 1000. Also accepts vanilla. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: vanilla). vanillite.toml: performance.spawning.axolotls-cap.

variables.name: Performance: Spawning › Underground Water Creature Cap
variables.description: Mob cap of glow squids (`underground_water_creature`, Vanilla 5). Applies to every world. Range: 0 to 1000. Also accepts vanilla. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: vanilla). vanillite.toml: performance.spawning.underground-water-creature-cap.

variables.name: Performance: Spawning › Water Creature Cap
variables.description: Mob cap of squids and dolphins (`water_creature`, Vanilla 5). Applies to every world. Range: 0 to 1000. Also accepts vanilla. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: vanilla). vanillite.toml: performance.spawning.water-creature-cap.

variables.name: Performance: Spawning › Water Ambient Cap
variables.description: Mob cap of fish (`water_ambient`, Vanilla 20). Applies to every world. Range: 0 to 1000. Also accepts vanilla. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: vanilla). vanillite.toml: performance.spawning.water-ambient-cap.

variables.name: Performance: Spawning › Hard Despawn Range
variables.description: Blocks from the nearest player beyond which a mob that may despawn is removed at once, and beyond which no mob spawns (Vanilla 128, fish 64). Fewer far mobs to tick. Deviation: mobs disappear closer to players. Applies to every world. Range: 8 to 512. Also accepts vanilla. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: vanilla). vanillite.toml: performance.spawning.hard-despawn-range.

variables.name: Performance: Spawning › Soft Despawn Range
variables.description: Blocks from the nearest player beyond which an idle mob may despawn by chance (Vanilla 32). Applies to every world. Range: 8 to 512. Also accepts vanilla. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: vanilla). vanillite.toml: performance.spawning.soft-despawn-range.

variables.name: Performance: Explosions › Max TNT Per Tick
variables.description: Primed TNT entities ticked per world tick; the rest wait (their fuse pauses) until a later tick. Keeps huge TNT chains from stalling the server. Deviation: above the limit, TNT explodes later than in Vanilla. Applies to every world. Range: 1 to 100000. Also accepts disabled. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: disabled). vanillite.toml: performance.explosions.max-tnt-per-tick.

variables.name: Performance: Hoppers › Transfer Cooldown
variables.description: Ticks a hopper waits after it moved an item (Vanilla 8). Higher values move items more slowly. Applies to every world. Range: 1 to 64. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 8). vanillite.toml: performance.hoppers.transfer-cooldown.

variables.name: Performance: Hoppers › Check Cooldown
variables.description: Ticks a hopper waits after it found nothing to move (Vanilla 1: it tries every tick). Saves the container and item lookups of idle hoppers. Deviation: a hopper notices new items up to this many ticks later; item sorters and clocks built on hopper timing run differently. Applies to every world. Range: 1 to 64. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 1). vanillite.toml: performance.hoppers.check-cooldown.

variables.name: Storage: Layout
variables.description: Folder layout of the dimensions: `"vanilla"` keeps every dimension in `<level>/dimensions/` like Vanilla and Paper; `"spigot"` puts the nether into `<level>_nether/` and the end into `<level>_the_end/` like Spigot and CraftBukkit, so the world can be opened by Spigot without conversion. A world found in the other layout is moved into this one once at startup. default: the profile's value (vanilla profile: vanilla). vanillite.toml: storage.layout.

variables.name: Storage: World Format
variables.description: Format of the chunk, entity and POI files of new worlds: `"vanillite"`, the own format (about 1.75 × smaller than Anvil, loads and saves several times faster, `vanillite export` writes a Vanilla copy), or `"anvil"`, Vanilla's region files. An existing world keeps its format unless `convert-world` is set. default: the profile's value (vanilla profile: vanillite). vanillite.toml: storage.world-format.

variables.name: Storage: Convert World
variables.description: Converts an existing world into `world-format` at startup, before it loads. The new files are read back and compared before the old ones are removed; if that fails, the world stays as it is and the server starts with it. default: the profile's value (vanilla profile: false). vanillite.toml: storage.convert-world.

variables.name: Storage: Keep Converted Files
variables.description: After a conversion the original files are moved into `world-format-backup/<time>/` in the server folder instead of being deleted. default: the profile's value (vanilla profile: true). vanillite.toml: storage.keep-converted-files.

variables.name: Storage: Compression Level
variables.description: zstd level of chunk records in the own format, 1 (fastest) to 19 (smallest). Takes effect for chunks saved from then on. Range: 1 to 19. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 3). vanillite.toml: storage.compression-level.

variables.name: Storage: IO Threads
variables.description: Disk IO threads shared by all dimensions. They only read and write files; compression runs on the compute pool. More help on network volumes with high latency. Range: 1 to 16. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 2). vanillite.toml: storage.io-threads.

variables.name: Storage: Commit Interval
variables.description: Seconds after which saves of unloaded chunks are made durable (synced when `sync-chunk-writes` is on). Save rounds and `save-all flush` commit at their end. Range: 5 to 300. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 30). vanillite.toml: storage.commit-interval.

variables.name: Storage: Read Ahead
variables.description: Reads the neighbours of a loaded chunk in its 4 × 4 tile along when they lie next to it in the file, and keeps them for a short time: fewer disk reads for moving players. default: the profile's value (vanilla profile: true). vanillite.toml: storage.read-ahead.

variables.name: Storage: Read Cache
variables.description: MiB of chunk records read ahead kept per dimension; under a memory limit (`performance.budget.memory`) at most 1/32 of it. Range: 0 to 65536. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 64). vanillite.toml: storage.read-cache.

variables.name: Storage: Max Open Files
variables.description: Region files kept open per dimension while unused; files in use always stay open. Range: 16 to 65536. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 256). vanillite.toml: storage.max-open-files.

variables.name: Storage: Max Pending Writes
variables.description: MiB of saved chunks waiting for the disk per dimension above which no more saves are queued: changed chunks stay loaded and save rounds pause until the disk caught up. Bounds RAM on slow disks. Range: 4 to 65536. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 64). vanillite.toml: storage.max-pending-writes.

variables.name: Storage: Autosave › Tick Budget
variables.description: Most microseconds of one tick spent capturing chunks for a save round; only the time left in the tick is used. ~380 chunks fit into the default. Range: 100 to 10000. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 500). vanillite.toml: storage.autosave.tick-budget.

variables.name: Storage: Autosave › Min Chunks Per Tick
variables.description: Chunks captured per tick even when the tick has no time left, so a round ends on an overloaded server. Range: 1 to 1024. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 16). vanillite.toml: storage.autosave.min-chunks-per-tick.

variables.name: Backup: Interval
variables.description: Minutes between backups; disabled makes none. The first one is made one interval after the start. Range: 1 to 525600. Also accepts disabled. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: disabled). vanillite.toml: backup.interval.

variables.name: Backup: Keep
variables.description: Backups kept; older ones are deleted after a new one is complete. 0 keeps all. Range: 0 to 10000. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 10). vanillite.toml: backup.keep.

variables.name: Backup: Directory
variables.description: Folder of the archives, relative to the server folder. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: backups). vanillite.toml: backup.directory.

variables.name: Backup: Compression Level
variables.description: Deflate level of the archives, 1 (fast) to 9 (small); 0 stores without compression. Region files are compressed already, so higher levels gain little. Range: 0 to 9. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 1). vanillite.toml: backup.compression-level.

variables.name: Watchdog: Early Warning After
variables.description: Seconds without a finished tick after which a first warning is logged. Range: 1 to 3600. Also accepts disabled. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 10). vanillite.toml: watchdog.early-warning-after.

variables.name: Watchdog: Warning Interval
variables.description: Seconds between further warnings while the server hangs. Range: 1 to 3600. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 5). vanillite.toml: watchdog.warning-interval.

variables.name: Security: Max Joins Per Tick
variables.description: Logins accepted into the game per tick. Protects the tick from join floods. Range: 1 to 1000. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 5). vanillite.toml: security.max-joins-per-tick.

variables.name: Admin: RCON Bind
variables.description: Address RCON listens on. Vanilla listens on `server-ip` (all interfaces when empty); Vanillite listens on the loopback interface unless this is changed. Empty = `server-ip` like Vanilla. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 127.0.0.1). vanillite.toml: admin.rcon-bind.

variables.name: Admin: RCON Min Password Length
variables.description: Shortest `rcon.password` accepted; with a shorter one RCON stays off (Vanilla only refuses an empty password). Range: 1 to 1024. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 8). vanillite.toml: admin.rcon-min-password-length.

variables.name: Admin: RCON Max Failed Logins
variables.description: Failed RCON logins per IP address and minute; after that, connections of the address are closed at once until the minute is over (Vanilla: no limit). Range: 1 to 10000. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 5). vanillite.toml: admin.rcon-max-failed-logins.

variables.name: Admin: RCON Max Connections
variables.description: RCON connections open at the same time (Vanilla: no limit). Range: 1 to 1024. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 16). vanillite.toml: admin.rcon-max-connections.

variables.name: Admin: Query Bind
variables.description: Address Query listens on. Vanilla listens on `server-ip`; Vanillite listens on the loopback interface unless this is changed (set `0.0.0.0` for public server lists). Empty = `server-ip` like Vanilla. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 127.0.0.1). vanillite.toml: admin.query-bind.

variables.name: Admin: Query Max Packets Per Second
variables.description: Query packets answered per IP address and second; more are dropped (Vanilla: no limit). Keeps the UDP listener from being used for reflection. Range: 1 to 10000. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 20). vanillite.toml: admin.query-max-packets-per-second.

variables.name: Commands: Max Command Length
variables.description: Longest command line that is parsed (Vanilla: the packet's 32767 characters). Range: 16 to 32767. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 32767). vanillite.toml: commands.max-command-length.

variables.name: Commands: Max Suggestion Input
variables.description: Longest tab completion input; longer requests get no suggestions (Vanilla accepts 32500 characters). Range: 16 to 32500. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 2048). vanillite.toml: commands.max-suggestion-input.

variables.name: Commands: Max Suggestions
variables.description: Suggestions per answer. Range: 1 to 10000. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 1000). vanillite.toml: commands.max-suggestions.

variables.name: Commands: Max Message Length
variables.description: Characters of a message argument (`say`, `msg`, `kick`). Range: 16 to 32767. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 256). vanillite.toml: commands.max-message-length.

variables.name: Commands: Max NBT Depth
variables.description: Nesting depth of SNBT in arguments. Range: 1 to 512. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 512). vanillite.toml: commands.max-nbt-depth.

variables.name: Commands: Max NBT Path Nodes
variables.description: Nodes of an NBT path. Range: 1 to 4096. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 256). vanillite.toml: commands.max-nbt-path-nodes.

variables.name: Commands: Max Selector Options
variables.description: Options inside one entity selector `[...]`. Range: 1 to 1024. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 64). vanillite.toml: commands.max-selector-options.

variables.name: Commands: Max Message Selectors
variables.description: Entity selectors inside one message argument. Range: 0 to 256. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 16). vanillite.toml: commands.max-message-selectors.

variables.name: Commands: Max Redirect Depth
variables.description: Nested redirects followed while parsing one command. Range: 1 to 1024. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 64). vanillite.toml: commands.max-redirect-depth.

variables.name: Commands: Bukkit Commands
variables.description: Paper's `/version` (also `/ver` and `/about`): the server's version or that of a plugin, for everyone with `bukkit.command.version` (all players by default); Vanilla's version dump moves to `/minecraft:version`. Off, `/version` is Vanilla's command for operators. `/plugins` is always there. default: the profile's value (vanilla profile: false). vanillite.toml: commands.bukkit-commands.

variables.name: Chat: Max Pending Messages
variables.description: Signed messages a player may have received without acknowledging them before it is kicked (`too_many_pending_chats`). Range: 64 to 65536. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 4096). vanillite.toml: chat.max-pending-messages.

variables.name: Movement: Too Fast Check
variables.description: Players that move faster than Vanilla allows are teleported back ("moved too quickly"). Vanilla's `playerMovementCheck` game rule. Applies to every world. default: the profile's value (vanilla profile: true). vanillite.toml: movement.too-fast-check.

variables.name: Movement: Elytra Too Fast Check
variables.description: The "moved too quickly" check also applies while gliding with an elytra. Vanilla's `elytraMovementCheck` game rule. Applies to every world. default: the profile's value (vanilla profile: true). vanillite.toml: movement.elytra-too-fast-check.

variables.name: Movement: Wrong Movement Check
variables.description: Players whose movement does not match the server's collision result ("moved wrongly") or that move into a block are teleported back, like Vanilla's `handleMovePlayer`. Off accepts every move that passes the other checks. Applies to every world. default: the profile's value (vanilla profile: true). vanillite.toml: movement.wrong-movement-check.

variables.name: Movement: Flying Kick
variables.description: Players floating in the air longer than Vanilla allows are kicked unless `allow-flight` is on. Not enforced yet: it needs block collision (milestone 3). Applies to every world. default: the profile's value (vanilla profile: true). vanillite.toml: movement.flying-kick.

variables.name: Exploits: TNT Duplication
variables.description: TNT can be duplicated with pistons and slime or honey blocks. Applies to every world. default: the profile's value (vanilla profile: true). vanillite.toml: exploits.tnt-duplication.

variables.name: Exploits: Carpet Duplication
variables.description: Carpets can be duplicated with pistons. Applies to every world. default: the profile's value (vanilla profile: true). vanillite.toml: exploits.carpet-duplication.

variables.name: Exploits: Rail Duplication
variables.description: Rails can be duplicated with pistons. Applies to every world. default: the profile's value (vanilla profile: true). vanillite.toml: exploits.rail-duplication.

variables.name: Exploits: Headless Pistons
variables.description: Pistons without a head can be created. Applies to every world. default: the profile's value (vanilla profile: true). vanillite.toml: exploits.headless-pistons.

variables.name: Exploits: Break Unbreakable Blocks
variables.description: Bedrock and end portal frames can be broken with pistons and explosions. Applies to every world. default: the profile's value (vanilla profile: true). vanillite.toml: exploits.break-unbreakable-blocks.

variables.name: Exploits: Gravity Block Duplication
variables.description: Falling blocks can be duplicated through end portals. Applies to every world. default: the profile's value (vanilla profile: true). vanillite.toml: exploits.gravity-block-duplication.

variables.name: Exploits: String Duplication
variables.description: String can be duplicated with tripwire mechanics. Applies to every world. default: the profile's value (vanilla profile: true). vanillite.toml: exploits.string-duplication.

variables.name: Exploits: Invulnerable End Crystals
variables.description: End crystals can be made invulnerable. Applies to every world. default: the profile's value (vanilla profile: true). vanillite.toml: exploits.invulnerable-end-crystals.

variables.name: Anticheat: Digging › Fast Break Check
variables.description: Validates "stop digging" against the server's own break progress: the time since the player started digging, the tool, Haste and Mining Fatigue, being in water and on the ground. Vanilla breaks a block whose progress falls short on the next tick once the player has been online for a while (it takes the start tick as the time spent), so a client that starts and at once stops digging breaks any block. On, a stop with too little progress waits for the progress to complete like a legit dig with latency and is rejected (the block is sent again, nothing drops) when it does not complete within the dig time seen so far plus one second. Instant mining, creative and normal digging with lag are not affected. Applies to every world. default: the profile's value (vanilla profile: false). vanillite.toml: anticheat.digging.fast-break-check.

variables.name: Anticheat: Anti X-Ray › Engine Mode
variables.description: "disabled" sends the real blocks (Vanilla). "hide" sends hidden blocks as the dimension's base stone (deepslate below y 0, netherrack, end stone). "obfuscate" sends hidden and replacement blocks as random hidden blocks (bigger chunk packets). Applies to every world. default: the profile's value (vanilla profile: disabled). vanillite.toml: anticheat.anti-xray.engine-mode.

variables.name: Anticheat: Anti X-Ray › Hidden Blocks
variables.description: Blocks that are hidden (block ids). Applies to every world. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: ["minecraft:coal_ore", "minecraft:deepslate_coal_ore", "minecraft:copper_ore", "minecraft:deepslate_copper_ore", "minecraft:raw_copper_block", "minecraft:iron_ore", "minecraft:deepslate_iron_ore", "minecraft:raw_iron_block", "minecraft:gold_ore", "minecraft:deepslate_gold_ore", "minecraft:redstone_ore", "minecraft:deepslate_redstone_ore", "minecraft:lapis_ore", "minecraft:deepslate_lapis_ore", "minecraft:diamond_ore", "minecraft:deepslate_diamond_ore", "minecraft:emerald_ore", "minecraft:deepslate_emerald_ore", "minecraft:nether_gold_ore", "minecraft:nether_quartz_ore", "minecraft:ancient_debris", "minecraft:mossy_cobblestone", "minecraft:obsidian", "minecraft:clay", "minecraft:chest", "minecraft:ender_chest"]). vanillite.toml: anticheat.anti-xray.hidden-blocks.

variables.name: Anticheat: Anti X-Ray › Replacement Blocks
variables.description: Blocks that "obfuscate" also replaces with random hidden blocks (block ids). Applies to every world. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: ["minecraft:stone", "minecraft:deepslate", "minecraft:oak_planks", "minecraft:netherrack", "minecraft:end_stone"]). vanillite.toml: anticheat.anti-xray.replacement-blocks.

variables.name: Anticheat: Anti X-Ray › Max Block Height
variables.description: Blocks at and above this height are always sent as they are. Applies to every world. Range: -2048 to 2048. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 64). vanillite.toml: anticheat.anti-xray.max-block-height.

variables.name: Anticheat: Anti X-Ray › Update Radius
variables.description: Distance in blocks around a changed block (mined, exploded, moved) within which hidden blocks are sent with their real state. Applies to every world. Range: 1 to 4. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 2). vanillite.toml: anticheat.anti-xray.update-radius.

variables.name: Proxy: Velocity Secret
variables.description: Shared secret of modern forwarding (the proxy's `forwarding.secret`). Empty turns forwarding off. With a secret, players' identities and addresses come from the proxy, signed with it; `online-mode` then only applies to direct connections. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: ). vanillite.toml: proxy.velocity-secret.

variables.name: Proxy: Allow Direct Connections
variables.description: With forwarding on, also accept players who connect directly instead of through the proxy (authenticated as usual). Off: they are refused. default: the profile's value (vanilla profile: false). vanillite.toml: proxy.allow-direct-connections.

variables.name: Multiversion: Versions
variables.description: Older versions whose clients may join: `"all"` (every version this build translates, currently 1.20.5 to 26.2), `"none"`, or a comma-separated list of releases such as `"1.21.4, 26.2"` (a release accepts every release of its protocol). Clients of the server's own version are not translated and pay nothing. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: all). vanillite.toml: multiversion.versions.

variables.name: Bedrock: Port
variables.description: UDP and TCP port (Bedrock 1.26.60 and newer join over NetherNet, which needs both). Bedrock's default is 19132. Range: 1 to 65535. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 19132). vanillite.toml: bedrock.port.

variables.name: Bedrock: Online Mode
variables.description: Require an Xbox Live login. Off accepts any identity a client claims: only for tests on closed networks. default: the profile's value (vanilla profile: true). vanillite.toml: bedrock.online-mode.

variables.name: Bedrock: Min Protocol
variables.description: Oldest Bedrock network protocol that may join. 0 accepts every Bedrock version this build supports (listed at startup); e.g. 2225 admits only Bedrock 1.26.60 and newer. Range: 0 to 100000. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 0). vanillite.toml: bedrock.min-protocol.

variables.name: Bedrock: Name Prefix
variables.description: Prefix of Bedrock players' Java names, so they never collide with Java accounts. Bedrock players get the UUID `00000000-0000-0000-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx` of their XUID (like Floodgate); whitelist and operators use that UUID. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: .). vanillite.toml: bedrock.name-prefix.

variables.name: Bedrock: Max Connections Per IP
variables.description: Bedrock connections per IP address. Range: 1 to 1000. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 8). vanillite.toml: bedrock.max-connections-per-ip.

variables.name: Bedrock: Max Packets Per Second
variables.description: Packets per second a Bedrock client may send before it is kicked. Range: 50 to 100000. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 1000). vanillite.toml: bedrock.max-packets-per-second.

variables.name: Bedrock: Max View Distance
variables.description: Largest chunk radius granted to Bedrock clients. Range: 2 to 32. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 12). vanillite.toml: bedrock.max-view-distance.

variables.name: Bedrock: Chunk Cache Sections
variables.description: Translated chunk sections kept for all Bedrock players (each section is translated once for every viewer). About 4 KiB each. Range: 0 to 1048576. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 16384). vanillite.toml: bedrock.chunk-cache-sections.

variables.name: Bedrock: Threads
variables.description: Threads of the Bedrock frontend. Range: 1 to 64. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: 2). vanillite.toml: bedrock.threads.

variables.name: Plugins: Enabled
variables.description: Load the plugins in `plugins/`. default: the profile's value (vanilla profile: true). vanillite.toml: plugins.enabled.

variables.name: Plugins: Safe Mode After Crash
variables.description: After a crash inside a plugin's code (a fatal signal or a watchdog kill), skip that plugin at the next starts until its library changes or `plugins/.crashed` is removed, so a supervisor (Docker, systemd) brings the server back. default: the profile's value (vanilla profile: true). vanillite.toml: plugins.safe-mode-after-crash.

variables.name: Plugins: Development
variables.description: Development: the console command `vanillite plugin reload <id>` loads a new build of a plugin at runtime and moves its state. Old builds stay in memory. Not for production servers. default: the profile's value (vanilla profile: false). vanillite.toml: plugins.development.

variables.name: Plugins: Pins
variables.description: Pinned SHA-256 hashes of plugin libraries, `id=hex,id=hex`. A plugin whose library has another hash is refused. Empty: the profile's value (vanilla profile: ). vanillite.toml: plugins.pins.

variables.name: Plugins: Runtime
variables.description: Which build loads the plugins. The Linux release archives and the Docker image run a static build, which cannot load libraries, and ship `vanillite-gnu` (built from the same commit against glibc) next to it: `"auto"` starts `vanillite-gnu` in its place when `plugins/` holds plugins (packages or Paper/Spigot jars), `"gnu"` always, `"static"` never (plugins are then not loaded). Other builds load plugins themselves and ignore this. default: the profile's value (vanilla profile: auto). vanillite.toml: plugins.runtime.

variables.name: Plugins: Bukkit › Auto Setup
variables.description: When `plugins/` holds Paper or Spigot plugins and the layer is not installed, download the layer release made for this Vanillite version into `plugins/bukkit/` and, without a Java 25 runtime, Eclipse Temurin into `plugins/bukkit/runtime/` (both checked by SHA-256). Off (offline servers): the log says what to download and where to put it. default: the profile's value (vanilla profile: true). vanillite.toml: plugins.bukkit.auto-setup.
